description: The owner's Large Diesel preset: a 14.9 L inline six, twin turbos. The owner's own preset, converted faithfully (a race cam at 0.9999, the air at 233 K, the muffler open: on purpose): stock-engine figures are no target of it. Its targets are the contract's and what the preset is meant to do; it has no published figure. The stock heavy-diesel figures are content/validation/tractor-15-inline-six.json's.
